value: controlling the in vivo activity of enzyme-like nanomaterials (nanozymes) in target tumor cells to destroy tumors
quote: Nanomaterials with intrinsic enzyme-like activities (nanozymes), have been widely used as artificial enzymes in biomedicine. However, how to control their in vivo performance in a target cell is still challenging. Here we report a strategy to coordinate nanozymes to target tumor cells and selectively perform their activity to destruct tumors.
